```yaml
name: E2E UI Tests on Kind (PR)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - '**.yaml'
      - '**.sh'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - 'deploy/**'

jobs:
  e2e-kind:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      # Playwright will use this URL to reach the UI
      UI_URL: http://localhost:8080
      # Keycloak credentials for UI login (if required)
      KEYCLOAK_USER: ${{ secrets.KEYCLOAK_USER }}
      KEYCLOAK_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCLOAK_PASSWORD }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Set up kind cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@v1
        with:
          cluster_name: kind
          config: .github/kind-config.yaml

      - name: Install kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3
        with:
          version: '1.30'

      - name: Deploy application to kind
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f deploy/k8s/
          # Wait for all pods to be ready
          kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=kagenti --timeout=120s

      - name: Port-forward backend service
        run: |
          kubectl port-forward svc/kagenti-backend 8080:80 &
          echo "Port-forward started on http://localhost:8080"

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: |
          npm install -g playwright
          playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run Playwright UI tests
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: /tmp/.playwright
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/91-run-ui-tests.sh
          scripts/91-run-ui-tests.sh

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
```
